investigations.description: One row per PSI investigation, flattened from the PSI API record.

start_date.description: MM-DD-YYYY, as in the PSI record; several are wrong (see digest)

contacts.description: investigator names from the PSI record contact block, '; '-separated

author_contacts.description: per-author name, affiliation, role and e-mail from the PSI record contact block

objective.description: objective text from the PSI record

tests.description: One row per test, test day or condition set. Dictionary and caveats: docs/tests-table.md.

test_id.description: test identifier from the source (test no., FLEX no., day code). When the source has none: `<accession>-r<source_row>`

row_kind.description: `test` (one test or burn), `test_day` (one row per day), `condition_set` (one test condition, possibly several runs), `planned` (pre-flight planning matrix, not flown)

date.description: test date (ISO). Null when the source date is missing, garbled or inconsistent

fuel.description: normalised fuel name(s), joined with `/`. For BASS / BASS-II rows whose label names only a shape it is inferred (`fuel_inferred`)

fuel_raw.description: fuel or material text as in the source (or as corrected, see `fuel_raw_original`)

fuel_fraction.description: fuel mole fraction of the fuel stream. For inverse flames (PSI-10, PSI-159 `config = inverse`) it is the ambient (chamber) fuel fraction

config.description: flame or sample configuration (normal / inverse, coflow, droplet, free / fiber-supported droplet, opposed / concurrent flow)

geometry.description: burner, nozzle, sample or droplet size as text

x_o2_ambient.description: O2 mole fraction of the surrounding chamber or cabin atmosphere (single value). Null for inverse flames, whose ambient is fuel + N2

x_o2_burner.description: O2 mole fraction of a burner oxidiser stream (inverse flames)

x_o2_min.description: range of ambient O2 over the row (a day or condition set may list several values). Ambient only: null for inverse flames

x_o2_max.description: range of ambient O2 over the row (a day or condition set may list several values). Ambient only: null for inverse flames

x_o2.description: deprecated, ambiguous; not in `data/export/tests.json`. The single O2 value as first parsed: ambient for most rows but the burner stream for inverse flames. Kept for backward compatibility; use `x_o2_ambient` / `x_o2_burner`

flow_cm_s.description: imposed air or oxidiser flow velocity (single value; null when the flow was ramped through several values)

n_flames.description: flames ignited on a test day

ignited.description: hot ignition yes/no (null for CFI-G "flash"). For PSI-25 only `False`, on the one row (O12) whose air-display cell says "no ign"; for BASS and BASS-II use `outcome`

burn_time_s.description: burn time. For PSI-39 it is the hot-flame burn time

outcome.description: PSI-25 and PSI-26 only, whose tables have no outcome column: how the flame ended, read from the crew's own words. `no_ignition` (never lit, or not sustained once the igniter was withdrawn), `extinguished` (a sustained flame went out with fuel left), `burned_out` (burned until the fuel was gone). Null when the words do not say: 145 of the 250 runs. See "Outcomes read from notes" below

outcome_cause.description: with `extinguished` only: `blowoff` (went out as flow was raised), `low_flow` (went out as flow was reduced or shut off), `nitrogen` (put out by the GN2 flow), `unspecified`

outcome_quote.description: the words the outcome was read from, verbatim; `extra.outcome_field` names the cell, `extra.outcome_doubt` gives a caveat where the reading is uncertain

ext_diameter_mm.description: droplet diameter at (hot / visible) flame extinction

burn_rate_k_mm2_s.description: burning-rate constant K (hot flame for PSI-39). PSI-69's "Burning rate; mm" column is K in mm²/s

cool_flame.description: `True` when cool-flame data exist (k_cool, cool-flame extinction diameter or an extrapolated cool flame). Never `False`: missing cool-flame data do not show there was none

flame_length_mm.description: measured flame length: video length, or Nikon still flame height

at_smoke_point.description: the log marks this flame as at its smoke point (`Smoke Height` / `SH ?` Y/N)

smoke_point_reviewed.description: `True` when the row is one of the 55 smoke points of the science team's review (`SmokePointReview-0g-3.xlsx`), matched to this single log row (review values in extra, `review_*`). Never `False`: points between two log rows are flagged `smoke_point_bracket` instead

extra.description: JSON object: uncaptured source cells, `<column>_original` values, notes and provenance

source_file.description: file the row came from, relative to the repo

source_row.description: row number in that file: 1-based data row for CSVs, Excel row number for spreadsheets

discrepancies.description: Curated conflicts between the PSI experiment tables and the raw sensor data, with the action taken. Source: data/corrections/tests_patches.json. See docs/tests-table.md.

id.description: patch id (D01, ...), as listed in tests.extra `discrepancies`

test_id.description: test id as in the PSI table (null for a note on a whole investigation)

test_id_now.description: test id in `tests` after a test_id correction

evidence_source.description: file and channel the evidence comes from

timeseries_features.description: Summary features of each per-test sensor time series. See docs/formats.md.

accession.description: key of the `tests` row the recording belongs to

test_id.description: key of the `tests` row the recording belongs to

test_point.description: code of the recording in the file name (21228A1, F068A03, S1); `FLEX-<id>-reduced` is the investigators' reduced data of a CFI test

source_file.description: raw file the features were computed from

oxidizer_gas.description: gas on this mass-flow controller, from the header gas code

radiometer_array.description: standard, cfi-g, cfi-droplet, cfi-droplet-reduced or saffire

radiometer_on_s.description: time the flame signal stays above threshold, igniter glow included

ignition_time_s.description: first sample with the flame signal above threshold

flameout_time_s.description: last sample with the flame signal above threshold

burn_duration_s.description: flameout minus ignition; 0 when no flame is detected

flame_threshold.description: detection threshold used (W/cm2 standard array, V CFI-G)

script_extinction_detected_s.description: event of the test script, relative to the first sample
